name: @scrutiny-fabric/mcp
description: Publish-first MCP server: any MCP host can publish SCRUTINY Fabric events without ever holding the signing key (#108).
//mcp-sdk: Pinned exactly, not ^: the tool-registration surface and its zod->JSON-Schema conversion moved between 1.x minors, and the pilot pins tool definitions as a rug-pull defense (report §8.3).
//core: Imported from source by the signer (serializeForId/computeEventId/eventIdMatches) and by A3/A4 builders. Core's exports point at its dist, so tsconfig `paths` and vitest aliases map it to ../core/src; a `pnpm start` from a clean checkout still needs `pnpm build` first.
//noble: Pinned exactly: the NIP-44 vectors are byte-exact against these versions; a bump is a deliberate re-validation, not routine upkeep (D6: hand-rolled @noble stack, no nostr-tools).
